_comment: California top-rated extension. Matches the GET /api/top-rated response shape. Sixteen California AAVs: the six named (Russian River Valley, Sonoma Coast, Paso Robles, Sta. Rita Hills, Calistoga, Napa Valley) plus the next ten most popular California AVAs (Oakville, Rutherford, Stags Leap District, Howell Mountain, Dry Creek Valley, Alexander Valley, Anderson Valley, Santa Cruz Mountains, Los Carneros, Spring Mountain). Eight top producers per AAV with their top varietals (1-5 star scale) and top vintages (100-point critic scale).
